# orchestrator endpoint inventory — generated by scripts/check_endpoint_auth.py
# DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. Regenerate with `python scripts/check_endpoint_auth.py --write`.
#
# SCOPE: declared mounted /api, /auth and /wopi routes, including all literal
# HTTP methods and WS. Router constructor/include prefixes are composed;
# unmounted routers and framework-generated docs/OpenAPI routes are excluded.
# Other mounted paths are reported separately; unsupported composition fails.
# Gate labels are static source evidence, not authorization/control-flow proof.
#
# pat=<decision> — personal access token scope the route needs, from
#   orchestrator/security/token_scopes.py: a scope, `any` (any scoped token),
#   `refused`, or `unmapped` (refused until classified; a test fails).
#
# Classifications:
#   gated:<gate>           — protected by a require_* / user_can_access_* helper
#   admin:<gate>           — admin-only; the fleet-scoped variant also
#                            rejects project-scoped MCP admins
#   internal:<helper>      — authenticated non-user service boundary
#   public:<reason>        — opt-out via `# nosec: public <reason>` on line above decorator
#   unscoped               — no gate detected; CI snapshot test will fail

POST   /api/vms                                                                         pat=jobs:write      gated:require_job_access
DELETE /api/vms/{job_id}                                                                pat=jobs:write      gated:require_job_access
GET    /api/vms/{job_id}                                                                pat=jobs:write      gated:require_job_access
GET    /api/voice/capabilities                                                          pat=chat:read       gated:require_approved_user
GET    /api/workspace-cache                                                             pat=jobs:read       gated:require_approved_user
DELETE /api/workspace-cache/{artifact_id}                                               pat=admin           gated:require_approved_user
DELETE /api/workspace-instances/{instance_id}                                           pat=admin           gated:require_approved_user
GET    /api/workspace-instances/{instance_id}                                           pat=jobs:read       gated:require_approved_user
GET    /api/workspace/status                                                            pat=admin           admin:_require_admin
POST   /auth/backchannel-logout                                                         pat=refused         public:OIDC back-channel logout — authenticated by Keycloak's signed logout_token
GET    /auth/callback                                                                   pat=refused         public:OIDC redirect_uri — authenticates by exchanging the Keycloak code
GET    /auth/login                                                                      pat=refused         public:OIDC handshake entry — redirects to Keycloak, no session exists yet
POST   /auth/logout                                                                     pat=refused         public:revokes whatever session the cookie names; a no-op without one
GET    /auth/me                                                                         pat=any             gated:get_current_user
POST   /auth/refresh                                                                    pat=refused         public:BFF session cookie is validated in-handler (401 without one)
GET    /wopi/files/{file_id}                                                            pat=refused         public:WOPI CheckFileInfo — access_token gate validated in-handler
GET    /wopi/files/{file_id}/contents                                                   pat=refused         public:WOPI GetFile — same access_token gate as CheckFileInfo
POST   /wopi/files/{file_id}/contents                                                   pat=refused         public:WOPI PutFile — access_token gate, write scope checked in-handler
